نلتو (form VIII)
# نَلْتَوِ (naltawi) /nal.ta.wi/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِلْتَوَى (iltawā)
# نُلْتَوَ (nultawa) /nul.ta.wa/: first-person plural non-past passive jussive of اِلْتَوَى (iltawā)
